title: NBD-009 LONE SHADOW
summary: This is my second Hemoxian's kit because I'm not fond of the first Thor. Actually, it is non-gundam by the look of it and the design is just... off. But Tastier has me interested since the introduction, then the Lone Shadow raised it further.
body: This is my second Hemoxian's kit because I'm not fond of the first Thor. Actually, it is non-gundam by the look of it and the design is just... off. But Tastier has me interested since the introduction, then the Lone Shadow raised it further.

These are well made model kits. Through and through with plastic quality on par with Bandai, firm snapfit, and attention to details design. Since they are humanoid model kits, I would look at the Kotobukiya, MODEROID, and Bandai's Figurise for comparison. And they all just can't compete except for the official licensing and brand name. Get one for yourself and you will see what I meant. From the boxes, to the content, and the experiences.

Recommended. They are as newbie friendly as MGSD lineup. The playability multiplies when you purchase more than one of these kits. Tastier has TWO versions, Lone Shadow has at least FIVE, then you can combine them into more varieties. What a deal!
